questions.stem: In atherosclerosis the aneurysm occurs due to? (1) Endothelial injury (2) Inflammation of wall (3) Decreased blood to muscle. (4) Obliteration of vasa vasorum (5) Decreased collagen synthesis
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) 2,3

questions.stemHtml: A 22-year-football player collapses on to the field and dies on the way to hospital. At autopsy the following was the finding of his heart. What is ikely etiology?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) the image shows hypertrophy of septum and left vernticular wall which is seen in hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, myosine heavy chain mutation is most likely cause of HOCM.

questions.stem: A 55-year - old presents with hand claudication, examination shows absent radial pulse. Biopsy from vessel shows giant cells, likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) giant cells in vessel are seen in both A and B age > 50 makes a diagnosis of giant cell arteritis.

questions.stem: A 54-year smoker presents with weight loss cough hemoptysis. Blood examination reveals calcium is increased sodium is normal, imaging shows a mass with cavitating and lymphnodes. what is most likely to diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) hypercalcemia is a paraneoplastic syndrome of squamous cell carcinoma of lung.

questions.stem: Obstruction in emphysema is due to?

options.label: A
options.text: Increased mucus glands in small bronchi

questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) in emphysema there is elastin damage in alveoli and terminal bronchioles, former leads to dilation of alveoli and later leads to loss of elastic recoil thus leading to functional obstruction during expiratory phase.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not true about sarcoidosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) coalescing granulomas are characteristic of tuberculosis, sarcoid granulomas are discrete and reticulin rich.
Correct Answer (A) hyaline membrane are made up of fibrinous exudate and necrotic cells.

questions.stem: A renal biopsy of a patient shows crescent shaped structures in the glomeruli and immunofluorescence turns out to be negative what is likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) all of the above can show Crescentic glomerulonephritis, but negative immunofluorescence is seen in ANCA associated (pauci immune) glomerulonephritis.

questions.stem: False about clear cell renal carcinoma is?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) clear cell RCC show 3p deletion.

questions.stemHtml: EM of a patient suffering from hematuria, hypertension, and proteinuria is as follows what is likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) the EM shows dense deposits along the BM thus diagnosis is Dense deposit disease (aka MPGN type II)
Correct Answer (B) ADPKD is associated with PKD-1 and 2 genes, ARPKD with PKHD mutation.

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a polyp in a 54 year old male presenting with bleeding per rectum is as follows, likely diagnosis
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) the polyp is pedunculated with branching glands characteristic of tubular adenoma.

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a intestinal biopsy in a child suffering from diarrhoea, steatorrhea and stunted growth is as follows, likely diagnosis is
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (D) the histology shows lipid vacuoles in the epithelial cells seen in abetalipoproteinemia.

questions.stemHtml: Pas stain of liver biopsy in a patient suffering from hepatitis is as follows, what is likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) histology shows PAS positive globules in liver characteristic of alpha one antitrypsin deficiency.
Correct Answer (D) Leydig cell tumors show rod shaped eosinophilic crystalloids within the cytoplasm known as crystalloids of Rinke.

questions.stemHtml: Gross examination of a testicular tumor is as follows, which marker is likely to be positive in this case?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) the gross image shows homogenous grey white tumor without any hemorrhage or necrosis suggesting it is a seminoma, OCT 3 is marker for seminoma in the given options.
Correct Answer (A) epithelial tumor. Brenner tumor is a tumor of epithelial origin which originates from Walthard cell rest.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not seen in MEN 2B?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) parathyroid hyperplasia is seen with MEN 2A and also MEN 1

questions.stem: FISH for Her analysis in breast carcinoma is advised in
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Her 2 neu is considered as negative if it is 0 or 1+ on IHC, it is considered as positive if it is 3+ thus no need to do FISH in these cases. If it is 2+ it is equivocal, so we need to confirm these cases with FISH.

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a tumor in a patient presenting with vertigo, bodily imbalance and tinnitus is as follows. What is the likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) the histology shows cellular areas in which there is a nuclei free zone which is known as Verocay body seen in Schwannoma.

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a bone tumor is as follows, what is likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) the image shows Homer Wright rosette characteristically seen in both Neuroblastoma and Ewings sarcoma, but in bone later occurs.
